aarti.tek: Victory, victory to you, daughter of Bhagīratha, moonlight to the cakora birds that are the hosts of sages, worshipped by men, nāgas and gods; victory to you, daughter of Jahnu.
aarti.pad1: You are born of the lotus feet of Viṣṇu, you shine on Śiva's head; you are Tripathagā, who flows by three paths (heaven, earth and the underworld), a store of merit, the washer-away of sins. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You carry pure, abundant water; you are cool and take away the three afflictions; you have fine whirlpools and garlands of waves that curl and curve. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: With the townspeople's offerings of worship, your stream shines, white as the moon; you break the burden of worldly existence, and are the basin round the wish-granting tree of devotion. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: The birds that live on your banks, the beasts and winged insects of water and land, the worms and the ascetics with matted hair: you nurture all of them alike. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Give Tulasīdāsa a mind that wanders along your banks, remembering the hero of the Raghu line; you are Kālikā to the buffalo-demon of delusion. ॥5॥
